title: Admin Section Response
description: Schema for the response containing section details with its fields and translations

fields.description: List of fields associated with the section's style

scope.description: Field scope (mobile rendering plan, section 6.4), derived centrally by the backend from translatability (display) and platform prefix: display=1 -> content; otherwise web_*/mobile_* -> web/mobile and unprefixed -> common. The CMS section inspector groups by this value and must not re-derive scope from the field name or display flag.

display.description: Whether the field is a content field (true) or property field (false)

translations.description: List of translations for this field

language_code.description: Language code or 'property' for property fields

languages.description: List of languages available for this section

data_table.description: Present only for form sections: the data table submissions are stored in. Lets the inspector show the storage name, whether the label is admin-locked, and a deep link to the Data browser (issue #56).

name.description: Immutable storage name (== form section id), used as the Data browser deep-link target

display_name.description: Current human label of the data table

locked.description: True when an admin manually renamed the table (provenance 'manual'); the form section's displayName field no longer overwrites it

list_source.description: Present only for entry-form-list and data-view sections whose table can be found: what the list editor may offer an author. A list names its columns by immutable keys (section_<input id>) that nobody can know by heart, so the pickers draw from this answer. It is the set the save check accepts. Never cached: it follows the inputs of the form inside the list.

data_table.description: The stored table the list reads; null while the form inside the list was never submitted

form_section_id.description: The form inside the list when the list reads that form's table (no data_table of its own); otherwise null

columns.description: Columns of the table: the inputs of the form (in form order) then stored columns no input owns

field.description: Immutable column key to store in the list's JSON fields

label.description: The name an author knows (the input name)

type.description: Value type: text, number, boolean, date or datetime

row_fields.description: Fields every record has (entry date, record number, who wrote it) with the places a list may use them in

type.description: Value type: text, number or datetime

column.description: May be a column or a visitor control of the list

sort.description: May be in the default order

filter.description: May be in the fixed filter and the conditions of quick actions
